notes: Tuition fee for non-EU students is not stated for this specific programme on the supplied pages. The collegegeld page gives institution-wide amounts (instellingscollegegeld) but does not say a Moroccan student pays this for Accountancy; therefore tuition is omitted. The language requirement evidence comes from the general In- en uitschrijfregels PDF and is not specific to Accountancy, but applies to all Dutch-taught bachelor programmes. The age 21 entrance exam evidence comes from a different programme's page; it is included as a general Inholland policy but not programme-specific. The documents list is based on the general regulations PDF (identity document, diploma, grade list with certified translation); these apply to foreign diploma applicants like the Moroccan student.

note.fr: Votre diplôme étranger (Baccalauréat marocain) doit être validé par la Centrale Studentenadministratie (CSA) d'Inholland avant l'admission. Envoyez votre demande via Studielink avant le 1 mai.
note.en: Your foreign diploma (Moroccan Baccalauréat) must be validated by Inholland's Central Student Administration (CSA) before admission. Submit your application via Studielink before 1 May.

evidence.quote: Heb je een diploma buiten Nederland behaald dan moet onder meer worden beoordeeld of dit gelijkwaardig is aan een Nederlands havo-, vwo- of mbo-diploma niveau 4.

note.fr: Si vous avez 21 ans ou plus et ne remplissez pas les conditions d'admission, vous pouvez être admis après avoir réussi l'examen d'entrée.
note.en: If you are 21 or older and do not meet the entry requirements, you may be admitted by passing the entrance exam.

evidence.quote: If you are 21 years of age or older and do not meet the minimum entrance requirements, you can still be admitted by passing the entrance exam.
